dependency_pins.about: Pinned inputs of the EglantinePS5 build. `make deps` (tools/deps.py) fetches every missing item and leaves existing checkouts and files untouched. Paths are relative to this repository; ../ means next to it, the layout the build expects.

items.name: dav1d
items.about: dav1d 1.5.4 source, the AV1 decoder for Switch 2 movies (The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time)

items.name: ffmpeg
items.about: FFmpeg source as pinned by Eden's cpmfile.json, built for the PS5 decoders

items.name: fmt
items.about: fmt 12.1.0 headers for the build-time startup checks

items.name: compiler-rt
items.about: LLVM 18.1.8 emulated-TLS runtime (emutls.c and its headers) for the PS5 build

items.name: pacbrew
items.about: OpenSSL and zlib for the PS5 from pacbrew v0.40.2

items.name: opengl-sdk
items.about: PS5 OpenGL 4.6 SDK 1.0.2 (launcher UI and the OpenGL renderer)

items.name: harfbuzz
items.about: HarfBuzz 12.3.2 source (MIT): shapes the launcher's Arabic, Thai and other non-Latin text. Only src/ and the licence are kept

items.name: boilerplate
items.about: PS5 Native App Boilerplate: Payload SDK v0.42, runtime libc.prx and the native packaging tool

items.name: lapy-owned-helper
items.about: Lapy one-shot elfldr owned-root helper with guarded target lifetime and balanced vnode ownership

items.name: lapy-payload-sdk
items.about: Official PS5 Payload SDK v0.42 used by the pinned Lapy helper

items.name: lapy-ps5log
items.about: Pinned ps5log/1 single-header client used by the upstream Lapy helper build

items.name: ps5-vulkan-tools
items.about: Mihawk's PS5_Vulkan: the RADV build and link recipes

items.name: ps5-payload-sdk-fork
items.about: Mihawk's PS5 Payload SDK fork used to build RADV
